description: Coupons: the issuance store, the Wix mirror adapter, the wecare-coupons Lambda, its three provisioner scripts, and six test files. Resolves HIGH-1 (appliedDiscounts transport), HIGH-2 (read the discounted total from Calculate Cart's own fields; assert the order total only on the Create Order RESPONSE), HIGH-3 for the coupon side (DECISION 5: the hold existence fact moves onto COUPON#<codeUpper> so every access is an exact-key operation), MEDIUM-6 (commit_redemption gains cart_id), MEDIUM-8 (AdditionalFee sends price + priceBeforeTax + priceAfterTax) and NIT-5 (the no-limitPerCustomer branch). Independent of FEAT-002 except that both are consumed by FEAT-003's shared-gate edits. Corresponds to plan.md items 1-11.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/wix-coupons-giftcards-20261001/plan.md (especially DECISIONS 1-5 and 8) and coupons-20261001.md sections 2.3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 BEFORE writing code. context.json replaces re-exploration of the repo; do not re-derive what it states.

Item 1 + 2: create amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/coupon_store.py. Namespaced rows on couponKey (COUPON#, COUPONUSE#, COUPONHOLD#, COUPONREDEEM#) per coupons section 4.1; the full section 4.2 attribute set in integer paise and integer basis points with currency compared explicitly against 'INR'; the section 5.4 validation table including `v % 100 == 0` refused as SUB_RUPEE_DISCOUNT_NOT_SUPPORTED. Add the DECISION 5 attributes activeHoldCartId and activeHoldExpiresAtMs to the COUPON# row. claim() is a conditional put on COUPON#<codeUpper>; hold()/release() are ONE conditional UpdateItem with ConditionExpression 'attribute_not_exists(activeHoldCartId) OR activeHoldCartId = :me OR activeHoldExpiresAtMs < :now'; commit_redemption(table, *, code, cart_id, order_id, customer_id) does claim -> counters -> hold delete in that order. limitPerCustomer absent means NO COUPONUSE# condition is applied and the row is still incremented for audit (NIT-5). Injected table resource and injected clock, no boto3 client, no ambient AWS. Reuse money.positive_paise and identifiers.new_uuid7 - do not invent parallels. No read-modify-write anywhere.

Item 3: write tests/test_coupon_store.py covering spec tests 1-21, plus a test enumerating every DynamoDB access pattern in the module and asserting each is an exact-key operation or the status-index Query with zero scan call sites (pins HIGH-3), plus a test that hold() is one UpdateItem carrying the DECISION 5 ConditionExpression with no preceding get_item, plus the NIT-5 no-limit branch.

Item 4: create amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/wix_coupons.py, constructed exactly like cart_v2.py - INJECTED request callable, no boto3, no secret read. POST /stores/v2/coupons, GET /stores/v2/coupons/{id}, PATCH /stores/v2/coupons/{id} with body exactly {'specification': {'active': False}} and no fieldMask. Every Wix-bound amount is a whole-rupee int via `//`; times are epoch-millisecond strings. Read ONLY coupon.id, specification.active and specification.type from any response - never a numeric field. Never parse a status out of an exception message.

Item 5: write tests/test_wix_coupons_contract.py covering spec tests 22-41 including 24a/24b and 37a/37b/37c (37c is the AST ban on parsing a status out of exception prose). Tests 25 and 26 must serialise the outgoing body with the same json.dumps call wix_ecom._request uses and assert `type(parsed[...]) is int`. Add tests/fixtures/wix_coupon_get_response.json.

Item 6: create amplify/functions/ecommerce/coupons/handler.py - five staff routes calling middleware.require_auth before ANY table access, and two customer routes resolving a customer_session, with POST /coupons/validate additionally going through rate_limit.check_rate_limit. validate returns a verdict from the closed vocabulary (ELIGIBLE, UNKNOWN_CODE, NOT_ACTIVE, NOT_STARTED, EXPIRED, USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED, CUSTOMER_LIMIT_REACHED, HELD_BY_ANOTHER_CART, WIX_MIRROR_INCOMPLETE) and NEVER an amount. The Wix key secret wecare/wix/headless-api-key is referenced by id and read LAZILY at request time, never at module scope. No logging expression touches the key, not even reduced to a bool.

Item 7: write tests/test_coupon_logging_and_vocabulary.py (spec tests 59-61) and tests/test_coupons_routes_and_registry.py (spec tests 62-64 only; test 65 belongs to FEAT-003). Test 59 is an AST walk of every logger.* argument, transitively through local helpers. Test 60 pins that a coupon code MAY be logged in full, so the deliberate asymmetry against gift cards survives a later tidy-up.

Item 8: write tests/test_coupon_reconciliation.py covering spec tests 42-51 and carrying DECISION 3 and DECISION 4. Test 48 asserts against a mocked Create Order RESPONSE readback: Money.from_wix(returned['priceSummary']['total']['amount']).paise == quote.total_payable_paise == verifiedCapturedPaise + giftCardRedeemedPaise (gift-card term 0), AND returned['priceSummary']['subtotal'] == cart['priceSummary']['subtotal'], AND Money.from_wix(returned['priceSummary']['totalAdditionalFees']['amount']).paise == quote.convenience_fee_paise + quote.convenience_gst_paise (MEDIUM-8), AND appliedDiscounts[0]['coupon']['amount']['amount'] byte-identical to cart['priceSummary']['discount']['amount'] (HIGH-1). The additionalFees[] entry sends all three of price, priceBeforeTax and priceAfterTax (price and priceAfterTax = fee + GST, priceBeforeTax = fee). Mark tests 43 and 48 xfail(strict=True) against SEAM-C1 / SEAM-C2; assert the endpoint and the option-(a) claim UNCONDITIONALLY. Add tests/fixtures/wix_cart_v2_coupon_applied_v2_shape.json.

Item 9 + 10: create scripts/provision_coupons_table.py (stack-wecare-digital-CouponsTable, partition key couponKey, status-index HASH status RANGE createdAt, PAY_PER_REQUEST, PITR enabled, TTL disabled and asserted in --verify - model on scripts/provision_payment_attempts_table.py), scripts/provision_coupons_role.py (wecare-coupons-role per coupons section 6: five DynamoDB actions on the table and index, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on secret:wecare/wix/headless-api-key-* only, own log group, trust with aws:SourceAccount 775261844268, no Scan, no wildcard action) and scripts/provision_coupons_routes.py (the seven route keys, AWS_PROXY payload format 2.0 targeting ...:function:wecare-coupons:live, one lambda:InvokeFunction statement per route with SourceArn scoped to .../zllr9lrg7j/*/*/coupons*, existing routes reported never recreated, --apply required and dry run the default).

Item 11: write tests/test_coupons_iam_and_table.py covering spec tests 52-56 and 58 as OFFLINE contract tests over the provisioner ASTs and policy documents, modelled on tests/test_provision_checkout_contract.py. Tests 52, 52a and 52b target scripts/provision_checkout.py, which FEAT-003 edits, so mark them xfail(strict=True) here. Test 57 belongs to FEAT-003.

Run the verification commands. Then set this FEAT's status to completed and record in findings: the exact xfail marks left in place and why, any spec test deliberately not written and why, and anything FEAT-003 or FEAT-004 needs to know.

ONE DELIBERATE DEPARTURE FROM THE BRIEF, AND IT MATTERS
The brief said to mark tests 52, 52a and 52b xfail(strict=True). Test 52a (test_the_iam_simulation_covers_every_action_the_policy_grants) is NOT marked, because it PASSES today - it is a subset relation (granted dynamodb actions subset of _SIMULATED_ACTIONS; policy table ARNs subset of the simulated tables list) and holds vacuously while nothing has been added. Marking it strict would have made it xpass immediately (a failure under this feature's own acceptance criterion) and, worse, would have switched off the only assertion that fires when SEAM-C3b adds the CouponsTable grant WITHOUT extending the two hard-coded lists - which is exactly the half-done seam MEDIUM-18 exists to catch. 52 and 52b assert facts that are absent until the producer lands; 52a asserts a relation that must never break. The reason is written into the test's docstring.

TWO OTHER DECISIONS WORTH KNOWING
* `specification.code` was added to wix_coupons.READABLE_RESPONSE_KEYS, making the exact set {coupon, id, specification, active, type, code} rather than the five the design lists. Reason: section 5.3.1 defines WIX_CODE_CONFLICT in terms of specification.code, and with only id/active/type the state is undetectable (a Get-by-id returning a different id cannot happen). `code` is a STRING, so the load-bearing property - NO NUMERIC FIELD IS EVER READ - is untouched and is asserted separately and exactly against wix_coupons.NUMERIC_RESPONSE_KEYS. Test 24a asserts both halves.
* A new test helper, tests/coupon_fake_dynamo.py, rather than extending tests/crm_fake_dynamo.py. The shared fake raises AssertionError on `OR` and reads a boto3 Key().eq() object for queries; coupon_store needs a three-way OR (the DECISION 5 hold gate) and a STRING KeyConditionExpression (because it holds no boto3 client at all). Teaching the shared fake would have meant editing a helper eleven other test files depend on, from a session owning none of them. The new fake keeps the same discipline: an unrecognised expression form raises rather than being assumed to succeed, and .scan() raises outright.

FOR FEAT-004 / the checkout workstream
* coupon_store.commit_redemption(table, *, code, cart_id, order_id, customer_id, clock=...) - cart_id is a parameter (MEDIUM-6), and the function is idempotent on (code, order_id), returning {'committed': False, ...} on replay. Call it once after capture is verified, from whatever performs the internal-order write.
* A counter the limit refuses at commit is REPORTED, not raised: the return carries usageCounted / customerUsageCounted booleans. Capture is already verified by then, so refusing would leave a paid order with no redemption record. Eligibility is refused earlier, by evaluate() and hold(). This was a judgement call the design left open and it is documented in commit_redemption's docstring.
* SEAM-C2's producer is looked up by the name `build_wix_order_payload` in website_checkout / wix_writeback / initiation / order_creation / finalization, called as producer(cart=..., quote=..., coupon=...). If it lands under a different name or signature, update SEAM_C2_PRODUCER / SEAM_C2_HOMES at the top of tests/test_coupon_reconciliation.py rather than weakening the assertions.
* SEAM-C6 is still open: config/lambda-env-manifest.json needs COUPONS_TABLE for wecare-coupons (the handler falls back to coupon_store.DEFAULT_TABLE_NAME, so it works without it, but the manifest should say so).
* SEAM-C7 / SEAM-C4: coupon_store.release(table, code=..., cart_id=...) is the call to make on a refused checkout and on abandonment. It is safe to call when no hold exists (the condition tolerates absence) and refuses only when another live cart holds the coupon.
* Deploy order is unchanged and nothing here was deployed: provision_coupons_table.py --apply, provision_coupons_role.py --apply, provision_coupons_routes.py --apply, deploy_all_lambdas.py wecare-coupons (needs the registry entry), provision_live_alias.py --apply, snapstart_publish.py. All three provisioners default to a dry run and require --apply.
